skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to conduct independent research and apply theoretical knowledge to practical problems.
Capacity to analyze complex issues related to agricultural economics and propose solutions.
Skill to identify economic and social issues related to agriculture and rural development and suggest feasible solutions.
Ability to critically evaluate the development of agricultural economics and rural areas.
Effective communication skills for presenting research findings and engaging in group discussions.
Capacity to independently manage and direct one's own learning process.
